tools.name: share_page
tools.description: Share a page or document and get back a review link to send to people. Pass "html" for a self-contained page, or "markdown" for a plan, spec, PR description or report — markdown is rendered to a styled, readable document for you, so prefer it whenever the thing you want a human to approve is prose r

tools.name: share_pages
tools.description: Publish a multi-page set — an entry page plus the pages it links to — into one room as a single atomic operation. Either the whole set lands or nothing changes, so a reviewer never opens a page whose links point at pages that were never stored. Use this instead of calling share_page N times whenever

tools.name: get_feedback
tools.description: Fetch the reviewer notes for a page shared with share_page, as markdown grouped by page. Each note carries the anchored text, the element and its markup as the reviewer saw it, so you can locate and apply it; each page heading carries a URL to read the whole page back, so you never have to guess whi

tools.name: resolve_feedback
tools.description: Mark notes resolved once you have actually applied them. This is what closes the loop: the note leaves the active list for every later get_feedback, and the reviewer who wrote it sees it marked resolved on the page — live, if they have it open — instead of finding their old note sitting next to cont

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: share_page, share_pages, get_feedback, resolve_feedback · Private data: share_page, share_pages, get_feedback · Public sink: share_page, share_pages.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: share_page, share_pages, get_feedback, resolve_feedback · Private data: share_page, share_pages, get_feedback · Public sink: share_page, share_pages

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "share_page" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
